{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Communique #44582.15k''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] report authored by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] for the attention of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. It detailed the Empire's knowledge of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in the wake of her actions at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
